verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for an enterprise SaaS CRM like Dynamics 365 Sales, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage-data collection, or any opt-out control. The cited items cover sales features, Copilot and AI agents, and the Dataverse Web API, none of which address telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
